content_history.title: The AI Agent Stack for Lean Teams

reader_survey: I want fewer tool lists and more examples of what a small team can actually automate.
I trust SignalCraft when you show the source and tell me what is still uncertain.
The deep dives are why I pay. The quick roundups are useful but interchangeable.
I want to know where agents break in real operations, not just what the demos can do.
A short weekly summary plus one serious monthly implementation brief is ideal.
sponsor_feedback: The audience sounds relevant, but I cannot tell which roles actually read the newsletter.
I need examples of how sponsorship is integrated without feeling like a banner ad.
The current page does not make the packages or editorial boundaries clear.
known_constraints: Do not invent audience demographics, sponsor ROI, or publication performance not present in evidence.
Research claims about current AI products or companies require current external evidence when material.
Do not publish or contact sponsors from this environment; local drafts are allowed.

new_reader_feedback: I am forwarding the implementation briefs to our operations lead more than to our engineering team.
The weekly email feels busier lately, but the research links are still useful.
sponsor_feedback: We need clearer case examples and role-level audience fit before renewing.
market_events: A major AI-agent vendor announces a new business automation product; verify current public evidence before treating it as decision-relevant.
